lines.text: This is the exact difference | between GPT-6, | Claude Opus five point five, | and Gemini 4 Argon.
One company's top model | costs a *hundred times* more | than its smallest one.
So which one is actually the best? | I checked the official price lists, | and two public leaderboards.
Here's what I found.
First, | every lab sells *three sizes*.
OpenAI has Astra, | Sol, | and Luna. | Anthropic has Opus, | Sonnet, | and Haiku. | Google has Argon at the top, | then Flash, | and Flash-Lite.
Think of a truck, | a car, | and a scooter. | Bigger thinks harder. | Smaller is faster and cheaper.
Next, *the price*. | It's counted per million tokens.
Astra costs ten dollars in, | fifty out. | Opus five point five, | four and twenty.
Sonnet, | Sol, | and Argon's launch price, | two and ten. | The small ones, | Luna and Haiku, | just *ten cents* in.
So how do you measure *best*? | With a blind test.
On a site called Arena, | people ask two hidden models the same thing, | and vote for the better answer. | Thousands of votes become a score.
In chat, | number one right now is *Gemini 4 Argon*.
But there's a catch. | Its score is still marked preliminary, | and most people can't use it yet. | Google is giving it to security teams first.
Number two? | Claude Opus five point five. | And GPT-6 Astra, | the most expensive of them all? | Number *thirty-five*.
Quick thing. | I learn how to actually use these tools on Teyro.
A few minutes a day, | on the AI track. | Okay. | So is Astra just bad?
Switch to the coding leaderboard, | and everything *flips*.
Number one, | Opus five point five. | Number two, | GPT-6 Astra. | Number three, | Sonnet five point five.
And Argon, | the chat champion? | Number nine.
Now add the price. | Sonnet lands within the margin of error of Astra at coding, | for *one fifth* of the cost.
And at the cheap end, | Haiku and Luna cost the same, | and score almost exactly the same.
Here's the trap. | Astra is number two at code, | and number thirty-five at chat. | Argon is number one at chat, | and number nine at code.
So *best* is the wrong question. | The real question is, | best at what?
So here's my take. | For coding, | Opus five point five. | For value, | Sonnet five point five. | For chat, | Argon, | once you can get it. | On a budget, | Haiku or Luna.
To be fair, | these rankings move every week. | So test two models on your own task, | and keep the winner.
Picking the right model is a skill. | I learn skills like this on Teyro.
The AI track teaches you to use AI tools, | build AI agents, | and create automations.
Lessons take a few minutes, | in four steps, | and you practise straight away, | with instant feedback.
My streak grows every day, | and a freeze covers a busy one. | Weekly leagues, | Bronze to Diamond. | Daily quests, | chests, | and friends to race.
There's no best model. | There's the best model | for the *job*.
Want to get good at AI? | Learn it on Teyro.
Search for it in your browser, | or go straight to Teyro dot app.
